_meta.notes: Relationships for the Swiss Reformation cluster. Use 'start_slug' and 'end_slug' to reference nodes by slug.
conventions: All records use 'start_slug' and 'end_slug' for node references (slug is the canonical identity for file-first workflow).
Keep 'id' as a unique numeric handle for the edge record (not used for node identity).
Use 'description' for a short human summary; carry structured evidence fields (evidence_url, citation_style, page_refs, source_note) when available.
When evidence is reused across multiple edges, prefer an ':Evidence' node and link to it via SUPPORTS/FRAMES/SUPPORTED_BY relationships.
Status values: PROPOSED | REVIEWED | APPROVED. Ingest will set provenance fields on import if missing.
